window.rule: T+0..T+3 published (2026-11-16..11-18); 11/19 captured but outside the 3-day publication cap

home_court.rule: h = sd(home margin) x Phi^-1(measured home win rate)
home_court.note: HCA is a restatement of an official count, not an estimated edge: with this h and this sd, two otherwise equal clubs get exactly the measured home-win probability. It is never fitted to results.

rho.definition: r(home margin, total points) over official finals, neutral-site games excluded
